text:
maya: quick ask — vendor portal shows UK-west H100 quota 0/8 for our demo pool. We have a customer run tomorrow 09:00 UTC, need a short-term plan. Can procurement or infra triage?

sam: on it. which project/tenant?

maya: tenant `prod-demo-uk`. I ran `gcloud compute quotas describe --project=prod-demo-uk --region=eu-west1` and it returns 0/8 GPUs. snippet from vendor: "Allocation pending PO approval, ETA 48-72h."

jordan: oof. vendor delays hit us a lot lately. two quick options: 1) swap demo to our `demo-fallback` pool (preemptible mix of A100s) or 2) run a smaller canary in us-west and stream results.

kai: +1 to fallback pool. latency will be worse for EU customers but should be fine for a demo. we can pre-warm the pool for 30m.

maya: would need a short DNS/region note for attendees. also need a quick smoke that model inference latency is acceptable (<300ms).

sam: I can trigger a canary run now. prepping a tiny TF job to smoke LLM endpoints.

procurement-bot: PO #PR-3142 status: "In review by finance" — expected approval EOD if no blockers. Contact: @kai for expedite.

kai: pinged finance. if we can't get PO today, let's plan fallback. who's volunteer to patch infra?

jordan: I'll open a tiny terraform PR to create an ephemeral `demo-fallback` slice and attach routing rule. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4021

sam: can confirm smoke script output. running now: ```
# smoke command
./tools/run_demo_canary --tenant prod-demo-uk --target demo-fallback --requests 10
```

sam: smoke looks OK: 10 requests, mean latency 280ms, 0 errors. logs: `2023-11-02T22:10:01Z INFO inference request ok`

maya: great. OK let's do fallback plan A: 1) apply jordan's PR, 2) switch demo routing to `demo-fallback` and 3) notify attendees with short latency note. If PO clears by EOD we'll reverse.

jordan: PR ready, tagging @infra-approvers. leaving it as ephemeral (TTL 6h).

kai: noted. i'll follow up with finance and give a go/no-go in 2h.

oncall: reminder: set alert for unexpected OOMs on fallback pool (rule: >5% errors in 15m). I'll watch the alerts during the handoff. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks all — will update the demo invite and add a note. If anything changes, reply here and I'll coordinate.
